wiki.title: Charlie Miller (North Carolina politician)
wiki.extract: Charles William "Charlie" Miller is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented the 19th district (including parts of Brunswick and New Hanover counties) since 2021. Miller previously served on there Brunswick County School board. Miller was elected to the North Carolina House in 2020 after legislative mid-decade redistricting created a new district.
